summary: Meal Planner feature testing (iteration 2). Backend 7/7 tests pass. All UI flows verified working: page load, day tabs, today highlighted in orange, modal open/close, search filtering, add meal, calorie meter, weekly summary update, remove meal (hover X), week navigation, 'This Week' button, 'Saved!' confirmation, and 'Order These' navigates to cart. Data persists via PUT /api/meal-plan.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Budget input onChange calls savePlan on every keystroke, could debounce to reduce API calls
